facts.text: Performance Profiling MCP proxy available in preview with runtime 18 and version 29
Records snapshots of processes during defined time slots to diagnose performance issues
Supports recording of browser activities, background tasks with job queues, and web service calls
Administrator users can create schedules for themselves and others; other users only for themselves
Maximum schedule duration is one week and maximum retention after completion is one week
Debugger cannot attach to a session while profiling schedule is enabled
Sampling profiler takes samples at evenly spaced intervals; short-lived code may not be captured
Agent-based profiling requires D365 ATTACH DEBUG permission set for profiling another user's session
